title: Read deferred computations
description: You can distinguish computations that run in this demonstration from helpers that are only defined.

steps.description: safe_divide is defined above the first calculation. The actual result1 expression uses x directly, and its displayed result is False.
expensive_computation prints a message and returns 42. With cached set to None, the demonstration displays that message and value.
make_lazy defines a wrapper with a computed flag and saved result. This snippet defines the helper without calling it.
lazy_if selects between the two supplied zero-argument functions. You can inspect its call separately from make_lazy.

steps.question: What value appears in the final Result line of this supplied call?

steps.description: The recording contains evaluating THEN followed by Result: 42. It contains no evaluating ELSE message.
